answer_1.quote: Tasks. We follow previous works to implement self-correction in simple factual questions with Yes/No answers and complex tasks. • Yes/No questions. We evaluate LLMs' capability of answering Yes/No on natural questions. • Decision making. We require LLMs to take actions step-by-step... • Reasoning. This measures LLMs' performance of parsing content and reasoning over several supporting documents. • Programming. We assess LLMs' performance of generating code blocks and text paragraphs...
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers (e.g., 'Yes' or 'No'), step-by-step actions, reasoning explanations, and code implementations.
